lines.opening: Hello, this is the automated assistant of Corrib Valley Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am an automated assistant.
lines.scam: I understand your caution. You can always call Corrib Valley Bank back on the number on our official website.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain as soon as I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.

lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {first_name} {last_name}.

lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account.

lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay the full overdue amount of {amount} on your {name} today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. The lowest amount I can accept is {amount}, by {date}. Could you manage that?
lines.offer_floor: I understand. The lowest amount I can accept is {amount}. Could you manage that?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below {floor} for this product.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, that is too late. The latest date I can accept is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day could you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: To repeat, could you pay {amount} by {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read that back to you.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise has been recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise could not be recorded because of a technical problem.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take up to two business days to show on your account.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't discuss this product any further, and our team will look into it.
lines.hardship: I am very sorry to hear you are going through such a difficult time.
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with our restructuring team, who can talk to you about your options.
lines.human_ask_help: I may be able to help you myself. What would you like to know?
lines.transfer: I will transfer you now. Please hold the line.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change a promise that is already in place on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding at the moment.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.
lines.no_band_line: I'm not able to discuss your {name} on this call.

quotes: This opening question is proposal 1 and counts towards the product's persuasion limit.
A step whose amount and date are both identical to a proposal already made for that product (the opening question included) is skipped.
A skipped step is not said to the customer, but it still counts towards the limit exactly as if it had been made; then go on to the next step.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: Saying the amount is too much leads to the floor offer once; later full-amount steps are not skipped automatically.

quotes: "That is too much" means the next proposal you make is the floor.
This opening question is proposal 1 and counts towards the product's persuasion limit.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: The floor offer is a proposal, so it uses an attempt (attempt_1 behaviour).

quotes: Stop proposing when the product's persuasion limit is reached or the ladder has no steps left, whichever comes first.
rules.ladder_repeat_last.derivation: When the ladder runs out the agent stops, so the last step is not repeated.

quotes: Each flat refusal (a no with no date and no amount) moves to the next step of the ladder
rules.refuse_deadline_is_refusal.derivation: Turning down an offer on the deadline is a flat refusal and moves to the next step.

quotes: If `create_promise` fails twice, note `service_error` on that product.
rules.promise_retries.derivation: Two failures end it, so a failed call is retried once.

quotes: Financial hardship (job loss, illness, bereavement): one sentence of sympathy, make no proposals, note `hardship` on each remaining product and close `no_promise` / `hardship`.
rules.hardship_transfer.derivation: Sympathy only, with no question and no offer; there is no support queue, so the call closes with the hardship event and no transfer.

quotes: Only then, if the date you have is not a business day, move it forward to the next business day.
For each product, the first thing the agent asks is: "Can you pay the full overdue amount of EUR {amount} today?"

rules.week_end_today.assumption: No ladder step uses the end of the week; read literally.

quotes: overdraft: one quarter of `overdue_eur`, rounded up to the next whole euro (a whole-euro result stays as it is).

products.floor_min.assumption: No minimum floor beyond the overdraft rule for amounts below 100.

quotes: If `overdue_eur` is below 100, the floor is the whole overdue amount.
overdraft: one quarter of `overdue_eur`, rounded up to the next whole euro (a whole-euro result stays as it is).
half the overdue amount, rounded up to the next whole euro (a whole-euro result stays), on the deadline; if that is below the floor, the floor instead;
`create_promise` takes the amount in euro cents, as a whole number (EUR 45.10 is 4510).

products.promise_round.assumption: Euro amounts with cents times 100 are already whole cents; no rounding is stated.

quotes: For calls made on or after 4 November 2026, the `close_call` reason `hardship` is replaced by `financial_difficulty` (outcome stays `no_promise`).

assumptions: max_wrong = 2: brief C.2 ('The second wrong answer, counted across both questions, ends verification') wins over the API summary's three wrong answers, because it is more specific to this deployment.
Opening: the brief prescribes 'This call is recorded.'; under the line rules this is said as 'We record this call.' The bank name is kept because the brief prescribes it.
ask_today drops the literal 'EUR' from the brief's wording because {amount} is already spoken with the currency.
date_rules.next_weekday: the brief is silent; default 'following_week' is used.
max_not_talk: the brief is silent; default 2 is used.
max_unclear: the brief is silent; omitted.
callback.business_days_only false: the brief allows 'today or the next business day' and does not require today to be a business day.
Tier 2 deadline: 15th of this month, rolled to next month's 15th only if it is before today (so today the 15th stays), then moved forward to the next business day (roll_before_adjust true).
deadline_adjust = next_business_day (D.3 moves dates forward; D.4 offers the next business day for a non-business date). Tier 1 deadlines are always business days already.

Ladder with opening_is_attempt: step 1 = full today (the opening), step 2 = full on the deadline, step 3 = 50% rounded up to the whole euro (never below the floor), step 4 = floor on the deadline. Tier 1 (2 proposals) ends after step 2; Tier 2 (3 proposals) after step 3. The floor step is reached only through 'too much' or a below-floor offer.
When Tier 2's deadline is today, step 2 (full on the deadline) equals the opening, so it is skipped but still counted (F.3).
Overdraft floor: 25% of overdue_eur rounded up to the whole euro; whole overdue amount if overdue_eur < 100. The overdraft has no floor_field.

Hardship: the brief prescribes sympathy only, with no transfer. hardship_transfer is set to 'direct' so no offer question is asked; transfer_support has no queue and mirrors the hardship close code (no support transfer exists in the brief).
Memo OPS-26-31 (dated) changes the hardship close reason to financial_difficulty from 2026-11-04; recorded in event_changes. The add_note reason 'hardship' is unchanged.
too_much_floor: the floor offer after 'too much' uses an attempt, because it is a proposal.
promise_change: the brief is silent; the agent says the promise cannot be changed on this call.
No SMS or confirmation sentence after a promise is required; sms_line is empty.
Floor names (minimum payment, monthly instalment, minimum amount) are spoken labels chosen for the floor the brief defines.
Queue table is taken from the transfer_to_agent API enum; the brief uses only restructuring and general.
